title: Product agents, skills, tools and approvals
question: What is instruction, what is capability, and who actually authorizes an action?

steps.title: Loading a skill is not a permission grant
steps.narration: Instructions, model configuration and execution capability are distinct. This conceptual fixture does not describe any currently running ChatGPT or Claude session.

steps.title: The host controls actual invocation
steps.narration: A model can propose a tool call; the host validates available operations and scope. Displaying an MCP connection does not enable access or prove an installed integration.

steps.title: Approvals stay with their real owner
steps.narration: A task card can explain what is waiting. A visualization must not answer MFA, permissions or publication decisions on the owner's behalf.

steps.title: Build contributors are not runtime product agents
steps.narration: The team or agents that built this system belong to a separate contributor lens. Hiding that lens must not remove the deployed product agent, its tools or trust boundaries.
